intel_workforce.title: Workforce optimisation
intel_workforce.subtitle: Labour the schedule needs against who is rostered, who is on approved leave, and who is qualified. Leave is read from HR; pay stays with payroll.
intel_workforce.efficiency_hint: Planned over actual labour minutes on completed operations
intel_workforce.by_centre_hint: Hours. Pending leave is shown as a risk and not deducted.
intel_workforce.empty: Nothing scheduled or rostered in this period.
intel_workforce.qualifications: Qualifications missing, expired or expiring within 30 days
intel_workforce.no_training: No qualification problems at rostered centres.
intel_workforce.performance_hint: Planned labour of the completed operations against the time logged doing them, per work centre. A measure of the work, not of any person.
